newsitem.title: USA: Gerleman joins Van Kampen to head Merritt System.
newsitem.headline: Gerleman joins Van Kampen to head Merritt System.

text.p: Troy Gerleman joined Van Kampen American Capital Investment Advisory Corp. this week to head up the Oakbrook Terrace, Ill.-based firm's Merritt System, a firm official said Wednesday.

Gerleman who had been a Cedar Rapids, Iowa-based hospital analyst for EVEREN Securities Inc., will run the Merritt System out of a new Cedar Rapids office set to open next month, according to Richard Ciccarone a senior vice president at Van Kampen.

The Merritt System is a municipal database and software program encompasing 2,000 hospital, public power and airport credits. Ciccarone said plans are being made to expand the system to other credit sectors.
